audience: Founders, CFOs, operations managers, procurement leaders
hypothesis: A transparent cashflow waterfall with an unexpected $90 result will outperform interchangeable template-based AI tips on completion and relevant subscriber conversion.
title: The AI Pilot Saved Time. Why Was Net Profit Only $90?
alternativeTitles: Why a Positive AI Pilot Still Might Fail the CFO Test
thumbnailConcept: White invoice with large $90 NET and three cost deductions
cta: PrismBay AI. Practical business systems, measured honestly.
creativeDifferentiation: White finance-statement visual with original waterfall and payback ruler; no dark-panel template.

thresholds.scale: 24h viewed-vs-swiped and average percentage viewed both above median of 10 comparable Shorts, with positive subscriber signal and no QA/policy issues
thresholds.retest: Strong retention but poor reach after sufficient Shorts feed exposure
thresholds.modify: First-second drop or weak cost waterfall comprehension
thresholds.stop: Misleading economics, audio defects, or persistent below-baseline completion after meaningful exposure

dataProvenance: Original hypothetical arithmetic from PB-ROI-030; not a company case study
